$comment: A malformed bar must produce a verdict, never a traceback. Each criterion below fails on main before this work: the adapter served a criterion with no 'target' and completion.py died on the KeyError.

criteria.target: d=$(mktemp -d); printf '%s' '{"authority_id":"G-1","criteria":[{"check":"tests_pass"}]}' > $d/G-1.json; REPO_GOVERNOR_ACCEPTANCE_DIR=$d python3 adapters/acceptance-file query acceptance_criteria get_criteria id=G-1 | grep -q MALFORMED_SOURCE
criteria.$comment: The reported shape, isolated: a missing target and nothing else wrong. Refused, not served.

criteria.target: d=$(mktemp -d); printf '%s' '{"authority_id":"G-2","criteria":[{"check":"command_exit","target":"true","command":"make lint"}]}' > $d/G-2.json; REPO_GOVERNOR_ACCEPTANCE_DIR=$d python3 adapters/acceptance-file query acceptance_criteria get_criteria id=G-2 | grep -q MALFORMED_SOURCE
criteria.$comment: The worse half: a key that is never read sitting NEXT TO a valid target reads as though two things are checked and only one is.

criteria.target: d=$(mktemp -d); printf '%s' '{"authority_id":"G-3","criteria":[{"check":"file_exists","target":"README.md","$comment":"why"}]}' > $d/G-3.json; REPO_GOVERNOR_ACCEPTANCE_DIR=$d python3 adapters/acceptance-file query acceptance_criteria get_criteria id=G-3 | grep -q '"ok": true'
criteria.$comment: Positive control. Without it the two above are satisfied by an adapter that refuses everything.
The guard is asserted where it will still be asserted after this issue closes. A check that lives only in a bar goes unguarded the moment the issue does.
